tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm cream by day, night sky navy at bedtime. Never pure white: the cream is what makes the site feel like a printed book.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, book pages, modals, the order summary. One step lifted from paper.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells: the photo upload zone, the footer, quiet panels inside a raised card.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All body and heading text. Legible on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunk and every -wash fill in both themes (11:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, helper text, page counts. 5:1 or better on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and resting card outlines. Decorative only; a control's border uses ink-muted or delft.

tokens.name: delft
tokens.usage: The brand blue, from delft tiles and heritage print rooms. Links, the star ceiling band, selected states, the wordmark. 7:1 on paper in both themes.

tokens.name: delft-wash
tokens.usage: Soft blue fill behind selected chips and info notes. Text on it is ink or delft.

tokens.name: on-delft
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a delft fill (7.8:1 day, 8.2:1 bedtime).

tokens.name: persimmon
tokens.usage: The happy orange-red of a hand-printed star. The one primary action per view (Make their book), sale and new markers. 4.9:1 on paper by day.

tokens.name: persimmon-wash
tokens.usage: Soft fill for promo strips and the New ribbon. Text on it is ink, never persimmon.

tokens.name: on-persimmon
tokens.usage: Text on a persimmon fill (5.2:1 day, 6.9:1 bedtime).

tokens.name: ballet
tokens.usage: Ballet pink piping, scallop edges and dedication cards. Decorative trim; text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: ballet-deep
tokens.usage: The child's name in script, monogram thread, small pink text on paper or paper-raised (5.4:1 day).

tokens.name: buttercup
tokens.usage: Star yellow. Stars on the delft ceiling, the rating star, the twinkle in the wordmark. Never text on paper (1.5:1 by day).

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Garden green from storybook illustration. Success fills (Book saved) and illustration accents. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on ballet, buttercup and sage fills in both themes (5.4:1 on sage, 8:1 or better on the rest).

tokens.name: ceiling
tokens.usage: The star ceiling band, the site header and the footer. Delft by day, a deep twilight blue at bedtime so buttercup stars still glow and the scallop hem still shows against the night paper.

tokens.name: on-ceiling
tokens.usage: Text and the cream wordmark on the ceiling (7.8:1 day, 10.4:1 bedtime).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px paper gap, then a 2px delft ring. 7:1 against paper in both themes.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Home hero only. Lowercase or sentence case.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section openers and the book title on a cover mockup.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: How a StoryStar book is made

styles.name: story
styles.sample: Once upon a Tuesday, Hazel packed a picnic for the moon.
styles.usage: Story text on book page previews. Max 60 characters a line.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Upload a photo and your child stars on every page.

styles.name: body-s
styles.sample: Hardcover, 32 pages, ships in 5 to 7 days

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small caps-style kicker above a heading. Uppercase, tracked.

styles.name: monogram
styles.usage: The child's name on covers and dedication cards, like an embroidered monogram. 28px minimum; never for sentences.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap, the piping inset gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, form field gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gutter between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between a heading and its content block.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding top and bottom; the star ceiling band height on mobile.

tokens.name: radius-book
tokens.usage: Book covers and page previews: square like a real hardcover, softened a touch.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, the photo frame, modals.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and story-world chips.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Raised cards and book mockups on hover. Soft, like paper lifting off a table.

tokens.name: shadow-book
tokens.usage: Book cover mockups only: a spine shadow on the left plus a resting shadow.
